snippet.title: METAL EDEN: ASKA Trailer
snippet.description:
Give it all, before shutdown.

Immerse yourself in the intense gameplay of METAL EDEN as you step into the role of its fierce protagonist, ASKA.
Unleash devastating combos in fast-paced combat, switch between brutal melee and high-tech ranged weapons, and take down enemies with style and precision.
From kinetic finishers to fluid transitions, every move is designed to keep the action relentless.

Explore a variety of alien environments using ASKA's unique mobility kit.
Every level is a playground of verticality and momentum.
This is not just combat, it's art.

METAL EDEN immerses you in an adrenaline-fueled sci-fi FPS that fuses fast-paced combat, cybernetic parkour, and an intricately crafted narrative world, where humanity's consciousness has transcended the body.

METAL EDEN releases on September 2nd 2025 on Steam, PlayStation and Xbox.

DOWNLOAD THE DEMO AND WISHLIST NOW:
